title: Gaoled Awakening
description: You awaken from a pleasant dream of plaudits and revelry to find yourself in a gaol cell, with no memory of how you came to be there.
objectives: Carry the boulder back to Rook.

title: The Hand That Guides
description: As you toil away amidst the downtrodden pawns, an enormous serpentine creature descends upon the site, forcing you to take a weapon in hand and fight for your very life.

title: Tale's Beginning
description: You gained your freedom and crossed the sea on griffin wing, only to have your pawn companion swallowed up by the Brine. Now alone, you must seek aid and information.

title: In Dragon's Wake
description: As the Arisen, you bear a deep connection to the dragon. Having heard that Melve was ravaged by its attack, you make for the village in the hope of regaining your lost memories.

title: One-Eyed Interloper
description: As you make for the capital to prove your identity, a gargantuan cyclops crashes into your midst. Such beasts have little care for titles and destinies, it seems.

title: Seat of the Sovran
description: You have arrived in Vernworth, capital of Vermund and seat of its Sovran. As the Arisen, it would seem that throne is yours to claim by right. Is this where your destiny begins?
objectives: Speak with Captain Brant in the tavern anight.

title: Monster Culling
description: You must earn the right to attend the coronation if you are to have any chance of proving your identity. Gain renown by aiding Vermund's soldiers in their monster-culling duties.
objectives: Cull the goblins at Trevo Mine.
Aid the soldiers sent to Harve Village.
Find the soldiers on Vermund's eastern edge.

title: Disa's Plot
description: Queen Regent Disa would pursue her ambitions at any cost— even at the expense of the kingdom. If you are to put an end to her schemes, you must uncover the evidence to prove them.
objectives: Search for evidence of Disa's misdeeds.

title: An Unsettling Encounter
description: Disa's plot may not be the only nefarious scheme unfolding within the palace. Minister Allard, one of the queen regent's staunchest supporters, also bears investigating.

title: The Caged Magistrate
description: An ally well versed in the Code of Vermund would make all the difference in proving the legitimacy of your claim. The magistrate in the palace dungeons may prove to be just that.
objectives: Find a place with plenty of tomes.
Lead Waldhar out of the dungeons.

title: The Arisen's Shadow
description: A shadow dogs your every step—perhaps sent by someone who did not take kindly to you prying into palace affairs? You had best confront this individual and find out their intent.
objectives: Wait a few days, then speak with Captain Brant.

title: Feast of Deception
description: The coronation is the perfect opportunity to expose Disa's schemes and unseat the false Sovran once and for all. Your preparations made, you set out to attend the grand event.
objectives: Dress formally and speak with Captain Brant.
Await Captain Brant's plan of action.

title: Nation of the Lambent Flame
description: The false Arisen displayed the power to control pawns at the coronation—a power Brant believes to be derived from the godsway. Make for Battahl and learn more of this artifact.

title: Flickering Shadows
description: You have arrived in Bakbattahl seeking answers about the godsway. As you try to find your feet in this unfamiliar land, someone gives you a suggestion of where to begin.
objectives: Find blue crystal shards for Ambrosius.
Seek information about larger blue crystal shards.
Seek "he who was dragon-forged" in Harve Village.

title: Convergence
description: At around the same time that a mysterious shrine rose from the sea off the coast of Harve Village, a passage revealed itself in the depths of Stormwind Cave.

title: A New Godsway
description: The Godsbane that Rothais entrusted into your care is no mere blade, but his own soul—the soul of an Arisen. This, it seems, is what Ambrosius has been so desperately seeking.
objectives: Give the wyrmslife crystals to Ambrosius.
See if the godsway is ready.

title: The Guardian Gigantus
description: Ambrosius has instructed you to pass the Godsbane blade he crafted from a relic of the Forgotten Sovran into the hands of Lord Phaesus.

title: Legacy
description: Led by the Godsbane blade, you followed Phaesus to Moonglint Tower, where he intends to create a dragon and control the world's fate. Your own destiny—the ultimate choice—is nigh.

title: Medicament Predicament
description: A merchant is no less than the sum of their wares. This simple truth is not lost on young Flora, who ventured out from Vernworth to procure a medicament sold only in Melve.

title: Ordeals of a New Recruit
description: To a monster, new recruits are simply easy pickings. As such, sending an untrained soldier into the heart of a harpy flock was probably not the wisest choice.

title: The Provisioner's Plight
description: Oft what matters is that the work gets done, not the hands that do it. When saddled with another's task, you can but hope that the trust you earn will make it worth the effort.
objectives: Deliver the provisioner's note to Markus.
Procure some harspuds and salubrious draughts.

title: Nesting Troubles
description: Melve's defenses are greatly diminished in the wake of the dragon's attack, making the village a target for all manner of opportunistic monsters.
objectives: Throw explosive casks into the saurian nest.
Throw a jar of poison into the saurian nest.

title: Brothers Brave and Timid
description: Norbert ventured into the forest to collect medicinal herbs, sorely needed in Melve in the wake of the dragon's fury. But he has yet to return, and his brother, Ian, is very worried.
objectives: Escort the brothers back to Melve.

title: 'Twixt a Rock and a Hard Place
description: While many develop strong ties to the land of their birth, there are no few who seek to leave their homeland behind. One can only hope that they will find happiness elsewhere.

title: Till Death Do Us Part
description: The lecherous Ser Ludolph has no qualms about abusing his station to get what he wants. And when that happens to be Gregor's wife, he has the man sent on an impossible mission.
objectives: Aid Gregor at the Illdoers' Resting Place.

title: Scaly Invaders
description: The people of Harve fled the dragon's fury, only to return to find the village occupied by saurians. However, they may yet reclaim their homes if you cull the scaly fiends.
objectives: Wait a few days, then return to Harve Village.

title: Trouble on the Cape
description: The people of Harve have regained their village, but are far from at peace. The monster threat has brought unresolved tensions to the fore, sparking conflict among the villagers.
objectives: Escort Zoran back to Harve Village.

title: A Beggar's Tale
description: Albert of the slums seems to be doing quite well for himself, but even his fellow beggars are baffled by how much coin he has in spite of his meager means.
objectives: Keep an eye on the beggar.
Visit Celina in a few days' time.
Visit Hilda in a few days' time.

title: Tolled to Rest
description: Once the site of a war between Vermund and Battahl, the ancient battleground is now overrun with monsters. Yet there is one soul who braves it still, driven by a sense of duty.

title: The Phantom Oxcart
description: The roads are well tended, but they are by no means fit to be traveled anight, and carts are prohibited from leaving after dark. All but one obey: the so-called phantom oxcart.
objectives: Find out who is behind the phantom oxcart.
Gather evidence and report to Captain Brant.

title: The Heel of History
description: In a land overrun with monsters, orphans are no rarity. The Gracious Hand provides for as many as it can, but one of its wards, a boy named Malcolm, seems to have gone missing.

title: Saint of the Slums
description: The slums of Vernworth are a harsh place, where illness is oft synonymous with death. Yet amidst the despair, the abbess of the Gracious Hand stands out as a beacon of hope.
objectives: Gather evidence and apprehend the abbess.
Deliver the miasmite to Lady Elena.

title: The Gift of Giving
description: The Gracious Hand is home to many an orphan, including one young girl whose kind heart impels her to do whatever she can to help the community that took her in.
objectives: Bring Daphne the bunch of flowers.
Return in a few days' time.
Obtain two pieces of gold ore.
Bring Daphne medicine for treating blight.

title: House of the Blue Sunbright
description: A maid serving a noble family in Vernworth has approached you with a request. You've not met her before, but she seems to know who you are. Just what does she want from you?
objectives: Wait a day or so, then return to the manor.
Procure the necessary supplies for Sebastian.
Give Sebastian something that reeks of cyclops.
Give Sebastian an antidote for blight.

title: The Expeditious Explorer
description: Self-proclaimed explorer that he is, Vidal is all too eager to pursue the rumors of the godsbeast's treasure. He hastily plans an expedition, undaunted by the perils that may await.
objectives: Supply Vidal with enough food and medicine.

title: The Inveterate Explorer
description: Still intent on finding treasure, Vidal has set up camp within Curiosity's Mountainside, the better to plumb its depths. But is he prepared for the dangers that lie ahead?
objectives: Supply Vidal with quality food and medicine.

title: Belle of the Bar
description: Adelina, the beloved serving girl of a local tavern, has gone missing. With no shortage of admirers worried for her safety, her whereabouts cannot be ascertained too soon.

title: A Noble Exchange
description: It seems that the masquerade held this day is no ordinary event, but an occasion of gift-giving. You yourself have received a gift, in the form of a finely wrought staff.

title: A Game of Wits
description: You have encountered the legendary sphinx, a beast of intellect who seeks to pit its riddles against sage and warrior alike. How will you fare against it?

title: The Nameless Village
description: Suspicions alone will not suffice if you are to expose the false Sovran. Venture to Vermund's eastern edge and scour for evidence that will help you prove him a pretender.
objectives: Investigate the false Sovran and report to Brant.

title: A Place to Call Home
description: A place to set down one's pack and put up one's feet makes all the difference at the end of a long journey. Looking to travel herself, Mildred has offered to lend you her home.
objectives: Occupy the dwelling for a week.

title: Vocation Frustration
description: It seems certain vocations are unavailable for registration at the guild hall at present, unless you have the weapons required to hand. Perhaps the townsfolk can tell you more.
objectives: Take the archistaff and greatsword to the guild.

title: Prey for the Pack
description: A pall hangs over the checkpoint rest town, as fear for the grandson of the local apothecary lines every face. It falls to you to find the boy, and spare him a grizzly fate.
objectives: Find Rodge and go to his aid.
Escort Rodge to the checkpoint rest town.

title: The Sotted Sage
description: You encountered Lamond, a tippled patron of the hot springs. But is that all he is? There's a curious air about him that hints at something more—unless that's just the sulfur?

title: A Poisonous Proposal
description: You encountered Jarle, an eccentric researcher who wishes to study the effects of poison on a living specimen. Whether indulging his request will benefit you remains to be seen.
objectives: Allow yourself to be poisoned by an asp.
Return to Jarle afflicted with asp venom.
Allow yourself to be poisoned by a venin harpy.
Return to Jarle afflicted with venin harpy venom.
Join Jarle at the meeting place.
Aid Jarle in being poisoned by the chimera.

title: Short-Sighted Ambition
description: For some, peaceful days breed not satisfaction, but a yearning for something more. So it is with the apothecary Isaac, who seeks to improve his lot by studying a grimoire.
objectives: Visit Isaac in a few days' time.

title: A Case of Sculptor's Block
description: You happened upon the estate of a noble marked for its collection of sculptures, but it seems to be one masterpiece short. Perhaps a word with the sculptor himself is in order.
objectives: Do extended battle with the griffin.
Wait a few days, then check on Fulvio's progress.
Attend the unveiling at Klark's estate.

title: Shadowed Prayers
description: An attempt was made on the life of the Empress of Battahl, and Ser Menella has asked your assistance in apprehending the assassin before he strikes again.
objectives: Go to Flamebearer Palace in the morning.

title: Crossing in Shadow
description: Who should knock upon your door late anight but an attendant to Her Majesty Nadinia, Empress of Battahl? Her purpose is as yet unknown, but it is clear that it demands secrecy.
objectives: Escort Nadinia without exposing her identity.

title: Hunt for the Jadeite Orb
description: On your wanderings, you encountered a man desperate to reclaim a stolen treasure: the Jadeite Orb.

title: Dreams Apart
description: You find yourself in a world unchosen—a desolate place, on the verge of plummeting into oblivion. If you would not face this chaos alone, you had best seek out your loyal pawn.

title: Halls of the First Dawn
description: Perhaps Rothais can tell you more of this "world unchosen" the Pathfinder spoke of. He is, after all, the Forgotten Sovran—and no one knows more of the watching one than he.

title: When Wills Collide
description: It appears Phaesus has been working to avert this world's destruction. Perhaps you should find out what he intends.

title: The Regentkin's Resolve
description: Sven seeks to orchestrate a full-scale evacuation of the citizenry, and you have pledged to lend him your aid.
objectives: Aid in the evacuation of Vermund.

title: Civil Unrest
description: The sudden changes in the world have sowed a deep unrest in the hearts of the Battahli people. You have been tasked with resolving their quarrels, to facilitate the evacuation.
objectives: Aid in the evacuation of Battahl.

title: A Scholarly Pursuit
description: There is no surer mark of the red clouds' advance than a pillar of light, and one now shines in Battahl. Join hands with Phaesus to forestall this land's destruction.

title: Wandering Roots
description: Calamity comes for all, even the elves of the Sacred Arbor. Though the seafloor shrine offers a chance for survival, this proud people remains rooted by their ancient code.
objectives: Aid in the evacuation of the Sacred Arbor.
Take the Arborheart Cutting to the seafloor shrine.

title: The Importance of Aiding Ernesto
description: Not even the impending calamity can dissuade Ernesto from fulfilling his duty. Charged with the defense of Volcanic Island and its people, he strives to save every life he can.
objectives: Aid in the evacuation of Volcanic Island.

title: Shepherd of the Pawns
description: Unaffected by the prejudices of his homeland, the Battahli soldier Henrique refuses to abandon the pawns of the Agamen Ruins. Yet though his cause is noble, time is not his ally.

title: Oxcart Courier
description: Oxcart service to Melve has resumed, and the proprietor of the carts has asked your aid in inspecting the road and delivering a letter. This could make a nice change of pace.
objectives: Make for Melve and deliver the letter to Lennart.

title: The Ornate Box
description: Amidst the bustle and clamor of Vernworth's marketplace, you espy a young man arguing with the proprietor of one of the shops.
objectives: Receive recompense from Sven in a few days' time.

title: Claw Them Into Shape
description: You encountered Beren, a beastren training recruits at the encampment by the border. Though he is a warrior of skill, his presence seems to be discouraging new enlistments.
objectives: Procure weapons and find a motivated soldier.
Find Beren a motivated soldier to train.

title: Beren's Final Lesson
description: Just as Beren's dismissal is decided, the cyclops returns to wreak its vengeance on the recruits—and this time, it isn't likely to be so easily repelled.
objectives: Pay Beren another visit before he leaves.

title: The Stolen Throne
description: The Sovran is said to be convalescing, and has yet to appear before the public. But if you are the one true Arisen, then who is this man now sitting upon your rightful throne?

title: Masked Correspondence
description: Sven bade you deliver a letter to a potential ally in his stead, as Disa does not allow him to attend masquerades—and there is no better opportunity for covert correspondence.
objectives: Deliver the letter to Lord Patrick.

title: A Magisterial Amenity
description: Being confined to a gaol cell was hardly a punishment for Waldhar; having his spectacles confiscated was the crueler sentence. Find them, and he might readily share his wisdom.

title: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
description: Wilhelmina, proprietress of the Myrmecoleon, is determined to exact vengeance on the man who wronged her—but what crime could possibly have inspired such hatred?

title: Gift of the Bow
description: You encountered Glyndwr, a lone elf wandering the streets of Vernworth. Elves are typically withdrawn and reluctant to travel, but curiosity has drawn this one out of the forest.
objectives: Make for Glyndwr's place of training.
Help Glyndwr train with his new bow.

title: A Trial of Archery
description: In preparation for his Trial of Archery, Glyndwr has devoted himself to training with the bow you gifted him. Now the time has come for him to show his people all he has learned.
objectives: Carry Doireann out of the ancestral chamber.

title: The Ailing Arborheart
description: Under the boughs of the Arborheart you encountered Doireann, a young elven woman, who informed you of the great tree's ailment, and that only the nourishing gwyfencha can cure it.
objectives: Check in with Sara again later.

title: Out of the Forest, Into the Forge
description: Though reviled by its creators, the elven dish nutriabh is apparently a delicacy among dwarves. And so a path to gwyfencha is opened; may your nose survive the trek.
objectives: Check in with Sara again later.

title: Readvent of Calamity
description: To suffer the dragon's attack once is a nightmare. To suffer it twice is nothing short of ill luck—and it seems Melve's fortunes are determined not to turn.
objectives: Visit Melve from time to time.

title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
description: A regiment of soldiers occupies Melve, keeping the villagers as prisoners in their homes and turning outsiders away.
objectives: Procure four swords and give them to Lennart.
Repel the soldiers stationed in Melve.
Bring word of Melve to Ulrika in a few days' time.

title: Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
description: You have been entrusted with the repair of a regalia sword wielded by generations of Vermundian rulers. Having it at your hip would do much to aid your claim to the throne.
objectives: Find someone to repair the dulled regalia sword.
Find fifteen or more pieces of glimmercoal.
Find someone else who can repair the regalia sword.

title: Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
description: Some time has passed since Sara—Brokkr's most promising apprentice—undertook the task of repairing the regalia sword. Perhaps you should go and see how it's coming along?
objectives: Deliver Sara to the cave entrance.
Return for the regalia sword in a few days' time.
Wait a day or so, then check on Sara.

title: Welcome to Battahl
description: As you wandered through Battahl, a man offered to buy you a drink at the local tavern, in exchange for a tale or two.

title: Spellbound
description: You encountered Trysha, a young girl living with her grandparents on the outskirts of Vermund. Fed up with her dreary days, she dreams of only one thing: studying magick.
objectives: Visit Trysha in a few days' time.
Check on Trysha in a few days' time.
Pay Eini a visit in a few days' time.

title: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
description: Residing in a manor in the checkpoint rest town is Myrddin, a sorcerer of great renown. He is even willing to share the secrets of his art—provided he finds you worthy, that is.
objectives: Revisit Myrddin in a few days' time.

title: Put a Spring in Thy Step
description: While traveling in the south, you encountered an old dwarf with an achy back, groaning in pain by the wayside. It would be most unseemly if you were to abandon him to his plight.
objectives: Visit Gautstafr's home for a reward.

title: A Veil of Gossamer Clouds
description: You are not the only one investigating the queen regent's plots. Her son, Regentkin Sven, has been prying also, and uncovered an intriguing letter that hints at untold secrets.
objectives: Investigate the letter and report back to Sven.

title: A Candle in the Storm
description: As the empress performed her supplications to the Lambent Flame, an assassin's dagger took aim at her back. Though the brigand was caught, the true mastermind is still at large.
objectives: Leak information to the Coral Snakes.
Uncover the truth behind the empress's death.

title: Mercy among Thieves
description: A gang of bandits has been menacing the highroad of late, targeting oxcarts with deadly efficiency. But their days are numbered, now that you have been called upon to rout them.
objectives: Visit the site of the oxcart raid.

title: Off the Pilfered Path
description: Though he yearns for an honest life, banditry is all that Hugo has ever known. Now freedom is within his grasp, but he knows not what to do with it. Perhaps you can advise him?

title: Tensions on the Highroad
description: You have been asked to escort Ser Augustin, backbone of the opposition against the queen regent, back to Vermund. Make for the highroad, and tell no one—not even Captain Brant.

title: Clash and Conclusion
description: When you reached the tower, you found your path obstructed by the storied mercenary, Raghnall. He seeks a challenge, and would have you earn your way through glorious combat.
